name: versus-v16-match-flow
description: Wait for two participants, run a countdown and server-authoritative first-to-score match, then reset scores and players for the next match.

replacements.old:
$ " usedClientMuzzle=" $ string(bUsedClientMuzzle)
        $ " serverMuzzle=" $ string(ServerMuzzle)
        $ " castSerial=" $ string(VersusCastSerial)
        $ " spawned=" $ string(SpawnedSpell));
}

defaultproperties
{
    bAllowHarryToDie=True
    bCanMoveInSpecialPause=True
    bUseEngineNetworkMovement=False
    Health=100
    VersusDirectMoveSpeed=260.000000
    VersusDirectAirScale=0.450000
    SelectedVersusSpell=0
    VersusAimStartTime=-1.000000
replacements.new:
$ " usedClientMuzzle=" $ string(bUsedClientMuzzle)
        $ " serverMuzzle=" $ string(ServerMuzzle)
        $ " castSerial=" $ string(VersusCastSerial)
        $ " spawned=" $ string(SpawnedSpell));
}

defaultproperties

    PlayerReplicationInfoClass=Class'HPVersusPRI'

// the RemainingTime countdown, so we intentionally do not override it.
